#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: run.sh <phase> <outname> <unity-cli args...>
# Runs unity-cli with explicit project/port, logs invocation to commands.txt, saves stdout+stderr.
set -u
EVD=/private/tmp/issue376-evidence/6000.3.25f1-final
CLI=/Users/akiojin/Workbench/unity-cli/work/issue-376/target/debug/unity-cli
PROJ=/private/tmp/issue376-unity-6000.3.25f1-final
phase=$1; name=$2; shift 2
mkdir -p "$EVD/$phase"
cd "$PROJ"
ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
printf '%s [%s/%s] %q --project-path %q --port 6548' "$ts" "$phase" "$name" "$CLI" "$PROJ" >> "$EVD/commands.txt"
printf ' %q' "$@" >> "$EVD/commands.txt"
"$CLI" --project-path "$PROJ" --port 6548 "$@" > "$EVD/$phase/$name.json" 2> "$EVD/$phase/$name.stderr"
rc=$?
echo "  -> exit=$rc" >> "$EVD/commands.txt"
cat "$EVD/$phase/$name.json"; [ -s "$EVD/$phase/$name.stderr" ] && { echo "--stderr--"; cat "$EVD/$phase/$name.stderr"; }
echo "[exit=$rc]"
exit $rc

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: wait-idle.sh <phase> [deadline_seconds]
# Read-only bounded polling: system ping + get_editor_state until the project matches and
# isCompiling/isUpdating are false on 2 consecutive readings (>=5s apart).
set -u
EVD=/private/tmp/issue376-evidence/6000.3.25f1-final
CLI=/Users/akiojin/Workbench/unity-cli/work/issue-376/target/debug/unity-cli
PROJ=/private/tmp/issue376-unity-6000.3.25f1-final
phase=$1; deadline=${2:-180}
mkdir -p "$EVD/$phase"; cd "$PROJ"
log="$EVD/$phase/poll.log"
echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) [$phase/poll] read-only poll: $CLI --project-path $PROJ --port 6548 {system ping | raw get_editor_state --json '{}'} every 5s, deadline ${deadline}s, 2 consecutive idle" >> "$EVD/commands.txt"
start=$(date +%s); ok=0
while :; do
  now=$(date +%s); el=$((now-start))
  [ $el -gt $deadline ] && { echo "TIMEOUT after ${el}s" | tee -a "$log"; exit 1; }
  p=$("$CLI" --project-path "$PROJ" --port 6548 --output json system ping 2>&1)
  s=$("$CLI" --project-path "$PROJ" --port 6548 raw get_editor_state --json '{}' 2>&1)
  pp=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.projectPath // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  c=$(echo "$s" | jq -r '.state.isCompiling // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  u=$(echo "$s" | jq -r '.state.isUpdating // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  echo "t+${el}s project=$pp isCompiling=$c isUpdating=$u" | tee -a "$log"
  if [ "$pp" = "$PROJ" ] && [ "$c" = false ] && [ "$u" = false ]; then
    ok=$((ok+1))
    if [ $ok -ge 2 ]; then
      echo "$s" > "$EVD/$phase/editor-state-final.json"; echo "$p" > "$EVD/$phase/ping-final.json"
      echo "IDLE confirmed at t+${el}s" | tee -a "$log"; exit 0
    fi
  else ok=0; fi
  sleep 5
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: verify-phase.sh <phase>   (read-only verification + evidence capture)
set -u
EVD=/private/tmp/issue376-evidence/6000.3.25f1-final
PROJ=/private/tmp/issue376-unity-6000.3.25f1-final
P=$1; cd "$PROJ"
prev=$(cat "$EVD"/*/editor-log-line-marker.txt 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1); prev=${prev:-0}
"$EVD/wait-idle.sh" "$P" 240 || { echo "IDLE WAIT FAILED"; exit 1; }
"$EVD/run.sh" "$P" info raw package_manager --json '{"action":"info","packageName":"com.cysharp.unitask"}' > /dev/null
echo "== info:"; jq -c '{success, error, message, v: .package.version, src: .package.source}' "$EVD/$P/info.json"
"$EVD/run.sh" "$P" package-list raw package_manager --json '{"action":"list","includeBuiltIn":false}' > /dev/null
echo "== list:"; jq -c '.totalCount, [.packages[]|select(.name|test("cysharp"))|{name,version,source,isDirectDependency}]' "$EVD/$P/package-list.json"
"$EVD/run.sh" "$P" registry-list raw registry_config --json '{"action":"list"}' > /dev/null
echo "== registries:"; jq -c .registries "$EVD/$P/registry-list.json"
"$EVD/wait-idle.sh" "$P" 120 || { echo "IDLE WAIT FAILED"; exit 1; }
cp Packages/manifest.json Packages/packages-lock.json "$EVD/$P/"
echo "== manifest/lock unitask:"; jq -c '.dependencies["com.cysharp.unitask"]' Packages/manifest.json; jq -c '.dependencies["com.cysharp.unitask"]' Packages/packages-lock.json
"$EVD/run.sh" "$P" console-errors raw read_console --json '{"count":200,"logTypes":["Error","Exception"],"includeStackTrace":true}' > /dev/null
"$EVD/run.sh" "$P" console-all raw read_console --json '{"count":300}' > /dev/null
echo "== console stats:"; jq -c '.statistics, .totalCaptured' "$EVD/$P/console-all.json"
echo "== console Error/Exception entries:"; jq -r '.logs[]|.logType+": "+(.message|split("\n")[0])' "$EVD/$P/console-errors.json"
n=$(wc -l < "$EVD/editor.log"); echo "$n" > "$EVD/$P/editor-log-line-marker.txt"
sed -n "$((prev+1)),${n}p" "$EVD/editor.log" > "$EVD/$P/editor-log-excerpt.txt"
echo "== editor.log lines $((prev+1))-$n: error CS count / key lines"
grep -cE "error CS" "$EVD/$P/editor-log-excerpt.txt"
grep -nE "error CS|Domain Reload Profiling|com.cysharp.unitask@|Csc .*UniTask.dll|Registered package" "$EVD/$P/editor-log-excerpt.txt" | head -15
